name: http-retry
description: Make outbound HTTP requests with configurable retry and exponential backoff. Retries on transient errors (429, 5xx) up to MAX_RETRIES times. EGRESS: allowed_hosts is ["*"], so this module's own host grant places no restriction on which host it reaches - the destination is whatever the node's config resolves to. What still constrains it: the worker's SSRF resolver (private, loopback and link-local addresses are refused), the bound actor's egress_scope (scope 'local' refuses public egress outright), and max_llm_tier (a tier1 actor is refused every external LLM host regardless of allowed_hosts). To pin this node to specific hosts, install a private copy and narrow allowed_hosts with update_module_hosts.

MAX_RETRIES.description: Maximum retry attempts after initial failure

BACKOFF_MS.description: Initial backoff delay in milliseconds (doubles each retry)

RETRY_ON_STATUS.description: Comma-separated HTTP status codes that trigger a retry
